record.paper_title: Recent progress and open problems in the Bergman space
record.context_brief: Boundary positivity for weighted biharmonic Green functions
record.original_question: For a finite zero divisor phi in the Bergman space L^2_a(D), let Gamma_|phi|^2(z,zeta) be the Green function for the weighted fourth-order operator Delta_z |phi(z)|^(-2) Delta_z on D with Dirichlet and gradient-zero boundary conditions. Is the exterior normal derivative partial_n Delta_z Gamma_|phi|^2(z,zeta) nonnegative for every boundary point z on the unit circle and every interior point zeta in D?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 4.2 For a finite zero divisor phi

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ be the open unit disk and let $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ denote the Bergman space of holomorphic functions on $\mathbb{D}$ that are square-integrable with respect to normalized area measure. A finite zero divisor is a function $\varphi\in L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ that vanishes precisely on a prescribed finite multi-set $\{a_1,\dots,a_n\}\subset\mathbb{D}$ (counted with multiplicities) and is extremal/canonical in the usual sense (the contractive divisor associated with this finite zero set).

For a positive weight $w(z)=|\varphi(z)|^2$ on $\mathbb{D}$, let $\Gamma_w(z,\zeta)$ be the Green function of the fourth-order weighted biharmonic operator
$$L_w u(z)\;=\;\Delta_z\!\bigl(w(z)^{-1}\,\Delta_z u(z)\bigr),\qquad z\in\mathbb{D},$$
with Dirichlet (clamped-plate) boundary conditions
$$\Gamma_w(z,\zeta)=0,\qquad \partial_n\Gamma_w(z,\zeta)=0,\qquad z\in\partial\mathbb{D},\ \zeta\in\mathbb{D},$$
where $\partial_n$ is the exterior unit normal derivative on the unit circle.

Question. Is it true that for every finite zero divisor $\varphi\in L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$, every boundary point $z\in\partial\mathbb{D}$, and every interior point $\zeta\in\mathbb{D}$,
$$\partial_n\,\Delta_z\,\Gamma_{|\varphi|^2}(z,\zeta)\;\ge\;0\ ?$$
artifact.category_tag: Weighted biharmonic Green functions on the disk
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface explicit Green-function computations for weighted biharmonic operators $\Delta w^{-1}\Delta$ on the disk (e.g., for rational and radial logarithmically subharmonic weights, and for $w=(1-|z|^2)^{-\alpha}$), establishing interior positivity of $\Gamma_w$ in several special cases. However, no source found explicitly resolves the stronger boundary positivity statement $\partial_n\Delta_z\Gamma_{|\varphi|^2}(z,\zeta)\ge0$ for general finite Bergman zero divisors $\varphi$; the status of this specific boundary-normal-derivative conjecture appears to remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: A computation of Green functions for the weighted biharmonic operators Δ|z|^{-2α}Δ, with α>-1
status_evidence.snippet: Explicit formulas and positivity of the Green function for specific radial weights on the disk.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity is established only for specific weights, not the general |φ|^2 finite-zero-divisor case.

status_evidence.title: Weighted biharmonic Green functions for rational weights
status_evidence.snippet: Algorithm for the Green function with rational weights; positivity verified in special cases including some Blaschke products with two zeros.
status_evidence.claim: Boundary normal-derivative positivity remains verified only in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Contractive Zero-Divisors in Bergman Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of contractive divisor property uses positivity of biharmonic Green function on the disk.
status_evidence.claim: Background motivating the conjecture; the boundary-positivity question itself is not settled here.
